suspension_reason: The downstream pipeline was rerun on August 2, 2026, but the current-price authority contained older July 22 and July 27 source observations. End-to-end snapshot identity and lineage were not enforced when the recommendations were generated.
reinstatement_requirements: A new immutable current-market snapshot is captured and certified.
The snapshot manifest contains provider provenance, source observation timestamps, file hashes, price-date coverage, and listing coverage.
The feature matrix is rebuilt exclusively from the certified snapshot for all current-state fields.
Every downstream summary contains the same source_snapshot_id and matching source hashes.
The end-to-end snapshot and lineage certification passes in strict mode.
Individual products pass freshness, listing-depth, forecast, and recommendation-stability gates.
